script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The experiment comparison says the result was already on the paper, but nothing establishes why. The image does not fit the Teacher testing pleasure and finding it futile.
Saying the Teacher is testing everything stretches the text. It describes particular things he tested, not literally everything.
Saying he is blunt because he is in the middle of an experiment supplies a reason the text does not give.
The oven-mitt comparison does not match wisdom guiding the Teacher while he embraces folly. It depicts protecting a hand from a hot tray instead.
The Teacher says he denied himself nothing his eyes desired, not that he obtained whatever he wanted.
The cookie-jar joke does not make sense as stated. Having a lid does not explain why Papa cannot get what he wants from the jar.
